risks.title: Tenant Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: GLPI's rental revenue is highly concentrated with PENN Entertainment, Boyd Gaming, Bally's and a few others. Default or distress of a top tenant would have a material adverse effect on cash flows.
risks.summary: Concentration with a small number of gaming operator tenants means any tenant bankruptcy, lease rejection or rent default would materially impair distributable cash flow.

risks.title: Gaming Industry Cyclicality and Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Tenants' ability to pay rent depends on regulated gaming revenues, exposed to consumer discretionary spending, state gaming policies and competition from online gaming.
risks.summary: Downturns in regional gaming demand, new gaming licenses or unfavourable regulatory changes could impair tenant solvency and indirectly GLPI's rental income.

risks.title: Interest Rate and Refinancing Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a REIT, GLPI has significant fixed-rate senior notes maturing on a staggered schedule. Higher-for-longer rates increase refinancing cost and depress equity valuation.
risks.summary: Rising interest rates increase the cost of refinancing maturing debt, weigh on cap rate spreads and reduce the affordability of accretive acquisitions.

risks.title: REIT Qualification and Tax Risk
risks.score_rationale: Loss of REIT status would subject GLPI to corporate income tax and prevent it from passing through earnings, materially reducing shareholder distributions.
risks.summary: Failure to satisfy complex REIT income, asset and distribution tests could trigger corporate-level tax and force a cut in dividends.

risks.title: Acquisition and Development Growth Risk
risks.score_rationale: Growth depends on sale-leaseback and development funding transactions with gaming operators in a competitive market with VICI and others.
risks.summary: Inability to source accretive acquisitions or fund development projects on favourable terms could limit dividend growth and total return.

risks.title: Property Concentration and Natural Disasters
risks.score_rationale: Many GLPI properties are concentrated in specific U.S. regions and exposed to hurricanes, flooding and other natural events. Insurance recoveries may be insufficient.
risks.summary: Property damage from natural disasters or regional economic shocks could reduce tenant operating results and rent coverage.
